remote_gpu_endpoint_audit.anti_fabrication_declaration: Because GARMENT_AI_REMOTE_INFERENCE_URL is unset and no authorized cloud GPU credentials are present in the local environment, remote neural 3D inference is officially documented as BLOCKED. Zero synthetic or mocked neural 3D inference results were generated. The existing procedural parametric deformation engine (UniversalGarmentFittingEngine) is maintained as the verified fallback.

trellis.name: TRELLIS (Microsoft Research)
trellis.architecture: Structured 3D Latent Diffusion (SLAT) + Gaussian / Mesh decoding
trellis.input_requirements: Single RGB image with alpha mask (1024x1024 recommended)
trellis.garment_category_support: General rigid/semi-rigid objects; fair on tops/dresses, struggles with thin pants/skirts
trellis.output_topology: Dense unstructured triangle mesh (150k-300k faces) or 3D Gaussians; non-manifold edges common
trellis.texture_quality: High-fidelity PBR texture bake from latent diffusion
trellis.silhouette_fidelity: Very high front silhouette alignment; hallucinated rear surface
trellis.component_completeness: Good sleeve separation; collared necklines occasionally solid (lacks internal cavity)
trellis.uv_quality: Automated xatlas parameterization; atlas fragmentation requires re-packing
trellis.rigging_compatibility: Requires volumetric remeshing (QuadRIF/InstantMeshes) and automatic skinning before avatar binding
trellis.recommendation: Leading general 3D candidate for isolated garment packshots, requires automated manifold retopology

hunyuan3d.name: Hunyuan3D-1.0 / 2.0 (Tencent)
hunyuan3d.architecture: Two-stage multi-view diffusion + feed-forward shape generation
hunyuan3d.input_requirements: Single RGB photograph with neutral background
hunyuan3d.garment_category_support: Broad object support; dresses and jackets well represented
hunyuan3d.output_topology: Isotropic surface mesh (80k-120k faces), water-tight closed manifold
hunyuan3d.silhouette_fidelity: Excellent front and side silhouette preservation
hunyuan3d.component_completeness: Hoods and collars cleanly delineated; inner clothing cavities frequently sealed
hunyuan3d.uv_quality: Clean UV atlas layout, low distortion
hunyuan3d.rigging_compatibility: Clean manifold geometry facilitates automatic linear blend skinning
hunyuan3d.licensing: Tencent Hunyuan Community License (Permissive with attribution)
hunyuan3d.recommendation: Highest geometric fidelity candidate; requires 24GB VRAM GPU instances (A10G or L4)

instantmesh.name: InstantMesh (Tencent ARC)
instantmesh.architecture: Zero123++ multi-view diffusion + Large Reconstruction Model (LRM) NeRF/Mesh
instantmesh.input_requirements: Single isolated garment image with white background
instantmesh.garment_category_support: All garment categories, but thin trouser legs often fuse together
instantmesh.multi_view_support: Generates 6 fixed viewpoints (front, right, back, left, top, bottom)
instantmesh.output_topology: FlexiCubes isosurface extraction; clean manifold but lacks garment thickness
instantmesh.texture_quality: Moderate blur on rear and occlusion regions
instantmesh.silhouette_fidelity: Good silhouette match from primary view
instantmesh.component_completeness: Sleeves reconstructed well; pocket flaps and seams smoothed out
instantmesh.recommendation: Fast and lightweight; well suited for real-time preview before high-res bake

stable_fast_3d.name: Stable Fast 3D (Stability AI)
stable_fast_3d.architecture: Triplane NeRF + marching cubes mesh extraction
stable_fast_3d.input_requirements: Single image with transparent or white background
stable_fast_3d.garment_category_support: Tops, dresses, shoes; poor on thin trousers and straps
stable_fast_3d.silhouette_fidelity: Moderate; small features smoothed by triplane resolution
stable_fast_3d.component_completeness: Sleeve cuffs and hemlines often sealed into blunt ends
stable_fast_3d.rigging_compatibility: Requires remeshing for clean joint deformation
stable_fast_3d.recommendation: Extremely fast (< 1s), ideal for mobile client low-latency draft reconstruction

pifuhd.name: PIFuHD (Facebook Research / USC)
pifuhd.architecture: Pixel-Aligned Implicit Function (multi-level deep MLP) for clothed humans
pifuhd.garment_category_support: Tailored specifically for clothing worn on human bodies
pifuhd.output_topology: Continuous implicit SDF surface meshed via Marching Cubes; non-parametric
pifuhd.texture_quality: Vertex color or projected RGB; no native UV map
pifuhd.silhouette_fidelity: Pixel-accurate front silhouette and fine wrinkle alignment
pifuhd.component_completeness: Reconstructs both human body and clothing as unified surface (cannot separate shirt from avatar)
pifuhd.rigging_compatibility: Difficult to rig clothing independently from body surface
pifuhd.recommendation: Restricted by non-commercial license and coupled human+clothing mesh

econ.name: ECON (Max Planck Institute)
econ.architecture: Explicit Clothed humans from Normal integration + d-BiPyFu implicit surface
econ.input_requirements: Single in-the-wild portrait or full-body fashion photo
econ.multi_view_support: Single-view front with inferred rear normal map
econ.output_topology: SMPL-X registered outer surface with detailed normal relief
econ.texture_quality: High geometric detail (folds/wrinkles), RGB texture projection
econ.silhouette_fidelity: Very high geometric fidelity to clothing wrinkles
econ.component_completeness: Coupled to SMPL body model; cannot export standalone garment GLB for wardrobe reuse
econ.recommendation: Excellent for fixed pose rendering, restricted by non-commercial license
